辉耀群星系列 裁判 FAQ
   ⼤家好！
      《符⽂战场》最新系列“辉耀群星”已经发布，为了及时解答⼤家关于规则
和卡牌效果的问题，裁判组在研读完核⼼规则后，第⼀时间整理了可能出现的常⻅疑
问，并与设计师团队⼀⼀进⾏了确认。

   请注意！本⽂档可以作为裁判判罚的依据，但不代表官⽅ FAQ。如果在未来官⽅
FAQ 与裁判 FAQ 存在冲突，请以最新版官⽅ FAQ 为准。


⼀、核⼼规则：“辉耀群星”系列更新公告中相关 QA
注：以下 QA 已在官⽅《核⼼规则：“辉耀群星”系列更新公告》中发布




如果我先打出“艾克 - 时间刺客”的主动技能，再打出⼀名单位，然后打出“来路不明
的武器”的主动技能，此时会发⽣什么？该单位会在我的下个回合被摧毁吗？

你的单位因⾃⾝触发式技能⽽被摧毁的事件，会被“来路不明的武器”的效果替换。虽然
该单位获得的⽂本是“在回合结束时，将我摧毁。”，但这与“在本回合结束时，将我摧
毁。”含义相同。在之后的回合中，这个技能不会再次触发。

卡⾯描述中的“在回合结束时”，与“在本回合结束时”是同义表达，虽然给予单位这样的
⽂本不太常⻅，但确实可能出现。如果该触发式技能结算后，单位仍留在场上，那么
它的技能的触发条件将⽆法被满⾜，因此不会再次触发。如果单位在该触发式技能触
发前移动到⾮场地区域，或从⾮场地区域移动到其他区域，它的所有临时状态都会被
移除，包括这段给予的⽂本。这样⼀来，该技能将不再存在，因此也就⽆法触发。

相关规则：359.3.e.16.、124.1.
 我可以通过“暗巷守护者”的[亮出]技能，亮出战场上⼀张正⾯朝下的卡牌吗？

不可以。卡牌正⾯朝下时，其正⾯的任何特征都⽆法被引⽤。

[待命]关键词只出现在卡牌的正⾯，也就是印有费⽤、名称、战⼒、规则⽂本等特质的
那⼀⾯。只要卡牌正⾯朝下，其他卡牌和效果便⽆法引⽤其正⾯的任何信息。因此，
即使这张正⾯朝下的卡牌对“暗巷守护者”⽽⾔是友⽅卡牌，它也不具有符合[亮出]要求

辉耀群星系列 官方 FAQ
欢迎来到 “辉耀群星”系列常见问题解答！正如“辉耀群星”发售说明中所说，我们会按惯例定期发
布常见问题解答，集中整理各项规则判例与疑难解答，作为发售说明的补充文档。

本常见问题解答是一份官方判例的汇编。如果本文档与《核心规则》存在任何不一致之处，请以
本文档为准。新版《核心规则》发布后，若其中有任何内容与本文档不一致，请以新版《核心规
则》为准。

在本文档中，我们使用了一些特定的缩写，来表示卡牌文本中的符号。以下是一份简要指南：

    ●   [E]代表“休眠”
    ●   [M]代表“战力”
    ●   [A]代表“任意特性的 1 点符能”
    ●   [C]代表“与此牌特性相同的 1 点符能”
           ○ “急速”费用中的[C]需要与单位拥有相同特性；若单位没有特性，则变为[A]。
           ○ 其他情况下的[C]则全部视为符合卡面印刷情况的相应符能标志——这种用法是我
             们在设计过程中采取的简称！

—




如果对手强化了“卡洛克斯”，并通过其触发式技能选择从我的废牌堆中打出我的“妮蔻 - 完美伪
装”，该对手会获得我在构筑卡组时选定的某位传奇吗？

不会。

当通过“卡洛克斯”打出的“妮蔻 - 完美伪装”的打出效果结算时，如果该玩家的卡组中包含至少一张
“妮蔻 - 完美伪装”，那么就可以将该玩家在构筑卡组时选定的一名传奇加入自己的传奇区域。其
处理方式与该玩家打出属于自己的妮蔻时相同。该玩家加入传奇区域的传奇，与其对手选定的传
奇没有任何联系。如果该玩家的主卡组和备牌中都没有“妮蔻”，则无视这项指示。
 如果我在控制“天界双足龙”时打出“动员”，且我的符文牌堆中只剩下一枚符文，此时我还能抽
一张牌吗？

不能。

以这种方式引用的行动，仅指代该游戏行动及其作用于的游戏物体。“天界双足龙”所指示的召出
事件会引入一个新的游戏物体来执行该行动，但被指代的行动仍然仅限于法术指示中的原始行
动。

如果玩家在场上有“天界双足龙”，且符文牌堆中仅剩两枚符文，此时打出“万世催化石”也适用同样
的逻辑。即使无法召出“天界双足龙”所指示召出的额外游戏物体，该玩家仍然能够召出两枚符
文。因此，该玩家不会抽一张牌。

相关规则：359.3.e.14.c.




如果我通过“细心的修复师”的触发式技能，从我的废牌堆中以[Y]的费用将其打出，我是否能利
用“莫德凯撒 - 铁铠冥魂”放逐废牌堆中的一张单位或装备，来支付这笔费用？
 可以。

“以[费用]的费用打出我”是一种替代费用，会将基础费用（[2]）替换为该替代费用（[Y]）。而“莫
德凯撒 - 铁铠冥魂”提供的符能可用于打出单位。

相关规则：356.1.a.




如果我打出“厄塔汗”，并摧毁一名非指示物单位来支付其额外费用，我是否能利用“莫德凯撒 -
铁铠冥魂”放逐该单位，来协助支付“厄塔汗”的符能费用？

不能。

在《符文战场》中支付费用时，需要先支付法力和符能费用，再支付其他“非标准”费用，例如“厄
塔汗”摧毁一名单位的可选额外费用。在支付“厄塔汗”的符能费用时，该单位尚未被摧毁，因此无
法从你的废牌堆中将其放逐。

相关规则：357.1.、357.2.
 如果我在对手的回合中摧毁“符刃铁砧”，我最晚能在什么时候打出被放逐的牌？

你可以在自己的下一个回合结束阶段开始前打出这张牌。

如果我在自己的回合中摧毁“符刃铁砧”，我能否在该回合的回合结束阶段打出这张牌？

不能。

"符刃铁砧"所赋予权限的持续时间为"直到你的下一个回合结束阶段"。这项权限仅在指定回合
的相应阶段开始前有效；一旦进入该阶段，权限便会失效。

如果我在自己的回合结束阶段摧毁“符刃铁砧”，我最晚能在什么时候打出被放逐的牌？

你可以在自己的下一个回合结束阶段开始前打出这张牌。

因为你已经处于当前回合的回合结束阶段，要到下一个自己的回合才会再次进入该阶段。只要那
个阶段尚未开始，你就仍可打出这张牌。




如果我控制着“猎风广场”，且场上没有“男爵巢穴”，我是否能以[9]和[C][C][C]的费用打出“纳
什男爵”？

可以。

“猎风广场”的费用减免适用于每名玩家在自己回合中首次在该处打出的单位或装备。“纳什男爵”在
“男爵巢穴”处进场是一个替换效果，在“纳什”男爵结算并进场时生效。而“猎风广场”的费用减免则
在确认过程中便已生效，涵盖第 2 步的打出位置选择和第 3 步的总费用确定。因此，当“纳什男
爵”的替换效果开始生效时，其费用已经确定并支付。
 相关规则：355.2.




如果我控制着一处战场，且我的传奇是“锐雯 - 放逐之刃”，我是否能在场上没有“男爵巢穴”的
情况下打出“纳什男爵”，并使其以活跃状态进场？

可以。

如果“锐雯 - 放逐之刃”的控制者将单位打出到自己控制的战场上，则会对这些单位应用一个替换
效果。这里指的是确认过程的第 2 步：玩家为打出的单位挑选打出位置。然后，“锐雯”会为这些
单位生成一个替换效果，使其以活跃状态进场。在这种情况下，“纳什男爵”进场时会受到两个替
换效果的影响：一个使其以活跃状态进场，另一个使其在“男爵巢穴”处进场。无论这两个替换效
果以什么顺序应用，“纳什男爵”都会在“男爵巢穴”处以活跃状态进场。

相关规则：355.2.




 “锐雯 - 断剑之誓”的休眠触发效果，是在触发式技能确认时消耗增益，还是在结算时消耗？
 结算时。

如果指示中的费用并非触发式技能效果的第一部分，那么这笔费用就属于结算时执行的指示，而
非该触发式技能的基础费用。“锐雯 - 断剑之誓”的触发式技能的第一部分是：“选择一个本回合未
选过的效果……”。

相关规则：383.3.b.




如果我同时对一名“锐雯 - 断剑之誓”和一名“天角牧者”执行标准移动，哪个触发式技能会先加
入结算链：是“锐雯 - 断剑之誓”的休眠触发效果，还是“天角牧者”的移动触发效果？

休眠触发效果。

移动事件完成后，结算链上的触发式技能会按以下顺序进行排列：休眠触发效果在先，移动触发
效果在后。这是因为执行移动所需的费用，会在实际执行移动行动之前支付。

相关规则：203.
 如果我尝试通过标准移动，将单位移到有“重力场”的战场，但选择不支付费用，此时我还能让
该单位变为休眠吗？

不能。

标准移动是一种自有技能。关于标准移动的处理方式，这里对已有共识作进一步说明：如果移动
本身无法完成，或无法支付其相关费用，就不能尝试执行标准移动。

此外，如果标准移动产生了无法支付的费用，或移动行动因其他原因无法执行，则会撤销此次标
准移动及执行过程中进行的所有行动。这些行动引发的效果也会一并撤销，标准移动随之取消。




如果我打出“魅惑妖术”，将一名敌方单位移动到我控制的“重力场”所在的战场，该单位的控制
者需要支付费用吗？

不需要。

虽然对手将单位移动到“重力场”所在的战场时必须支付[1]和[A]，但“魅惑妖术”指示的是由你移动
该敌方单位，而不是由对手移动。

如果该战场上的“重力场”由对手控制，那么在“魅惑妖术”结算时，就需要由你支付[1]和[A]，才能
将该敌方单位移动到该战场。

相关规则：412.2.及其子规则
 如果“提灯亚龙”与“重力场”位于同一战场，我打出“提灯亚龙”的主动技能时，又会发生什么？
对手是否需要支付费用，才能将单位移动到该战场？

是的。

与“魅惑妖术”不同，“提灯亚龙”指示由对手移动其单位，因此对手必须支付费用，才能将单位移到
该战场。如果对手选择不支付或无法支付这笔费用，该单位就不会移动。

相关规则：412.2.及其子规则、204.4.、204.4.b.、204.4.c.




说到“提灯亚龙”，如果对手打出其主动技能并选择我，而我对自己的一名单位打出了“气敛神
聚”，那么当“提灯亚龙”指示我移动一名单位时，即使我还控制着其他单位，也可以挑选那名单
位吗？

不可以。
 被选中的对手只要有能够移动的单位，就必须执行移动这一游戏行动。如果该对手控制着无法移
动的单位，就不能选择“移动”这类单位来满足移动指示，因为这类单位实际上无法移动。如果该
对手没有任何能够移动的单位，则撤销这项指示。如果该对手有可以移动的单位，就必须移动其
中一名。




如果我打出“据为己有”，获得对手的“艾克 - 逆时而行”的控制权，我是否能打出他的主动技能
将他放逐，然后再打出他？他再次进场后，仍由我控制吗？

能，而且仍由你控制。

相关规则：378.、191.2.

Radiance Rules Update Effective October 16, 2026

Welcome to the patch notes for Riftbound, Radiance edition. Included in today’s update are rules for playing with Radiance’s new mechanics, updates from the Vendetta FAQ, improvements to the rules’ logical infrastructure to better prepare for future sets and mechanics and a collection of scenarios to help folks understand some of the more complicated interactions introduced with Radiance.

Unique Radiance Interactions

While the patch notes and core rules are aimed at arming our judges, we wanted to include questions and answers prepared by the design team for some of the more tricky interactions and cards released in that set. This article will be released in addition to an FAQ article in the window when we’ve previously released FAQ articles.

Although this article is not an FAQ, it still is a collection of official rulings. These rulings are based on the Core Rules Document that also releases today, as well as the wording of the cards. When a new version of the Core Rules Document is released, it will take precedence over any points that differ from this document.

Throughout this document, we use some specific shorthand to represent symbols in card text. Here’s a short guide:

  • [E] means “exhaust”
  • [M] means “Might”
  • [A] means “one power of any domain”
  • [C] means “one power of this card’s domain”
    • [C] in Accelerate costs takes on the domain of the Unit, or turns into [A] if the Unit has no domain or multiple domains.
    • [C] in other cases is treated as the corresponding power symbol in all respects, matching how the cards are actually printed—it’s just a design shorthand!

What happens when I play Ekko, Boy Who Shattered Time’s activated ability, play a unit, and then play Unlicensed Armoy’s activated ability? Will the unit be killed on my next turn?

Your unit’s death from its triggered ability will be replaced by Unlicensed Armory. Although the unit has the text “Kill me at end of turn.” appended to it, that text is synonymous with “Kill me at the end of this turn.” On subsequent turns, it will not trigger.

When “at end of turn” appears on card text, it is used synonymously with “at the end of this turn.” Although granting that text to a unit is strange, it isn’t outside the bounds of possibility. If the unit remains on the board after the triggered ability resolves, the condition for its ability to trigger will no longer be able to be fulfilled, so it will not trigger again. If the unit changes zones to or from a non-board zone prior to the triggered ability triggering, all of its temporary modifications—including this granted text—will be removed. As such, the ability will no longer exist to trigger.

Relevant rules: 359.3.e.16., 124.1.

Can I show off a facedown card at a battlefield with the Show Off ability of Gutter Guardian?

You cannot. Facedown cards don’t have any referenceable characteristics from their front side.

The keyword “Hidden” only appears on the front side of the card; that’s the side with the cost, name, Might, and rules text among other traits. While a card is facedown, any information on its front side cannot be referenced by other cards and effects. Although a facedown card may be friendly to Gutter Guardian, it doesn’t have the appropriate characteristic to be shown off. Note that only the card from hand is revealed with Show Off. You don’t reveal the friendly objects on the board that you’re Showing Off, so you can’t reveal the facedown card even if you wanted to.

Relevant rules: 811.5.a., 129.4.

What’s up with the reminder text on Chronobreak? Do I get to choose the order?

You get to choose the order if you own all of the units being banished. If you control some number of units that you don’t own and banish those units as well, the units you banish will be placed on the chain starting with units owned by the current turn player and then proceeding in turn order.

Items cannot be placed on the chain simultaneously for any reason. If chain items would be played simultaneously, their controller chooses the order they go on the chain. If multiple players would add items to the chain simultaneously, they place their items on the chain in turn order instead, starting with the current turn player. In the case of Chronobreak, each player chooses the order of their own units being played to the chain (this is what the reminder text is referring to), but each player plays their units to the chain in turn order, starting with the current turn player.

Example: You control five total units, two of which are owned by your opponent. You play Chronobreak, choosing all five units. You banish them, then for each, their owner plays them to the chain as pending items. You’re the current turn player, so you play your three units first in the order of your choice, then your opponent plays their two units in the order of their choice. Pending chain items are finalized from oldest to newest and units resolve as soon as they’re finalized. Thus, we go up the chain starting with the first unit you played to the chain, finalizing and resolving all of the pending units on the chain until there are no more units on the chain. Then we finalize any play effects of those units in the order they triggered. Finally, players can react to the most recent item on the chain. If they don’t, that item resolves, and we repeat the process until all items on the chain have resolved.

Relevant rules: 303.2.a.

What happens when I play Transpositionist’s activated ability choosing an empowered Gangplank, Naval with 6 [M]? Can I play Angler Wyrm?

Gangplank being returned to hand will be replaced with him being given +3 [M] this turn. You can play Angler Wyrm from hand with Transpositionist’s activated ability.

Transpositionist returns a unit to hand and then references that unit’s information. If the unit didn’t change zones and it was a legal target as the instruction that targeted it was being processed, the activated ability will reference that unit’s current information. Gangplank, Naval’s current Might as it is referenced is 9 [M], allowing you to play a unit with 9 [M] or less.

Relevant rules: 359.3.e.13., 359.3.e.13.a.

What happens when I choose an attached Equipment with Orianna, Lady of Clockwork? 

It detaches from the object it is attached to when it becomes a unit. Although its equip ability can be activated and it can be targeted by Weaponmaster triggers, it cannot attach to a unit; nothing will happen when those abilities resolve.

In this rules update we’ve clarified that units cannot be attached to other game objects. If a unit were to be attached to a game object, it would need to stop being a unit first. If a non-unit game object becomes a unit, it will detach from anything it is attached to as it becomes a unit. If an effect would attempt to attach a unit to another game object without making it no longer a unit first, nothing happens.

Relevant rules: 143.5., 435.1.h., 718.6.

What happens when I choose a gear with Deploy located at a battlefield with Orianna, Lady of Clockwork?

That gear will become a unit-gear when the triggered ability resolves; if their controller doesn’t control that battlefield, they will apply contested status to that battlefield, and a combat or showdown will be staged there in the subsequent cleanup. When the chain clears, that showdown or combat will open.

Relevant rules: 190.3.a., 323.7, 323.8., 323.11., 323.12.

What happens when I choose another gear with Orianna, Lady of Clockwork and the previous unit-gear stops being a unit? Will its attached Equipment fall off? If it’s a deploy gear in base, do I get to move it?

Its attached Equipment will remain attached, and if it is a Deploy gear in base, it will remain in base.

Although units cannot be attached to objects, other objects have no such compunctions. Any attached Equipment that don’t become units will remain attached to the gear even after it stops being a unit. Their Might bonus won’t apply, since the gear doesn’t have a Might, but they will continue to apply their effect text to the gear they are attached to.

The majority of gear with Deploy reference “this battlefield” or “hold here” in such a way that gaining a benefit from base is not possible. That being said, if you want to move it back to a battlefield you can either turn it into a unit again with Orianna, Lady of Clockwork or you can use movement effects that specify moving gear, such as Command: Attack.

Note that there is a small gap between finalizing the Orianna, Lady of Clockwork trigger causing the previous unit-gear to stop being a unit, and the triggered ability resolving and causing the new gear to become a unit. During that gap, neither gear is a unit unless it was already one prior to ever being chosen by Orianna, Lady of Clockwork.

Relevant rules: 137.3.b.

So how does Neeko, Blending In actually work? When do I choose the legends, do I get three legends per Neeko in my deck, can I add multiple of the same legend to the Legend Zone, do the legends enter ready, and do I need to reveal them to my opponent?

You choose the legends during deck building—at competitive OPL, you must register those legends as part of your deck list, and you can store them with your sideboard. The 3 legends are shared by all Neekos in your deck. You cannot add multiple of the same legend to the Legend Zone. The legends enter ready. You do not need to reveal them to your opponent until they are added to the Legend Zone.

Let’s break down Neeko’s rules text. If your deck (Main Deck or sideboard) has one or more copies of Neeko, Blending In, you pick three legends in addition to your starting Champion Legend. Those 3 legends must be different from each other and from your Champion Legend. Regardless of how many copies of Neeko you have in your deck, you will choose three legends in this way.

When Neeko’s play effect resolves, its controller picks one of the legends chosen during deck building and adds it to their Legend Zone alongside their Champion Legend for as long as Neeko is on the board. If Neeko leaves the board, that legend will also cease to exist. The legends don’t exist in any zone of the game while they’re not in the Legend Zone; they don’t exist at all. That being said, if one or more of those legends are already on the board, a player can’t choose to create additional versions of those legends; they can have at most one legend on the board per legend chosen during deckbuilding. If somehow a player played a fourth Neeko, they would fail to add a legend to their legend zone.

The legends added this way are not tokens. They are legend cards and behave in all ways like normal legends do. If an effect instructs a player to “ready a friendly legend” they can target and ready any legends controlled by them or an ally. If an effect instructs a player to ready “your legend,” that refers to any legend controlled by that player. Such an effect does not target a legend; the legend is chosen as the spell or ability resolves.

Relevant rules: 103.1., 440.2.a., 440.3.b., 440.3.c., 355.10.g.

What happens when the unit on the board that I Showed Off with Primordial Roar is returned to my hand with Star-Crossed? Do I still deal damage? What about if I play Lunar Boon and discard the unit from hand?

You still deal damage in both scenarios.

Any referenced characteristics of shown off objects are locked in when you show them off. Regardless of what subsequently happens to them, their information will be able to be checked by the card that showed them off. This also means that giving a unit +[M] or -[M] after showing that unit off will not affect the damage dealt by Primordial Roar; it’s too late by that point.

Relevant rules: 832.1.d.1.

What counts as reducing a unit’s Might for Ahri, Confident? If I play Discipline on my 1 [M] unit while it’s stunned and located at the same battlefield as an enemy Leona, Zealot, will I trigger their Ahri, Confident located at that battlefield?

Reducing a unit’s Might means an ability of an object you control causes a unit to receive a -[M] effect. Ahri, Confident will trigger if you Discipline a stunned 1 [M] unit at the same battlefield as an enemy Leona, Zealot.

Although Discipline never causes the unit’s Might to increase, the unit goes from 1 [M] with a -0 [M] effect applied to it, which will not trigger Ahri, Confident, to 3 [M] with a -2 [M] effect applied to it. This change in state triggers Ahri, Confident, the same as a 3 [M] unit being stunned and receiving a -2 [M] effect from Leona, Zealot’s passive ability. Note that this doesn’t work for other cases: if a stunned 3 [M] unit at the same battlefield as an enemy Leona, Zealot has Discipline played on it, that unit will not have a new Might reduction effect applied to it and thus Ahri, Confident will not trigger. Spells, triggered abilities, and activated abilities are easier; if a spell, triggered ability, or activated ability applies non-zero -[M] to a unit, Ahri, Confident will trigger.

Core Rules Changes

The Unleashed and Vendetta rules updates have laid a relatively stable base for this rules update. We’ve made small changes as necessary, but we have fewer logical holes to patch, and there aren’t any sweeping fixes that need to be implemented in this set. The vast majority of the rules in this update are about new cards and mechanics in the Radiance set.

Now let’s take a look at the rules changes we have in store for Radiance!

—

Radiance Addition: Deploy

  • Deploy is a new keyword appearing on gear in Radiance. Gear with Deploy enable players to apply localized, battlefield-altering effects.
  • Gear with Deploy can be played to any battlefield; enemy occupied, friendly, or uncontrolled. However, when an opponent holds a battlefield where you have gear with Deploy, those gear will be killed.
  • Gear with Deploy remain at their current battlefield so long as they aren’t destroyed. Some effects can move gear with Deploy to other battlefields too!
    • NEW RULE: Deploy keyword added.

Radiance Addition: Disarm

  • Disarm is a new keyword appearing on units in Radiance.
  • Disarm is an attack trigger. The first time a unit with Disarm attacks each combat, they will give an enemy unit at their battlefield -1 [M] this turn. If a unit has Disarm 2, they’ll give an enemy unit -2 [M] this turn.
  • Disarm stacks just like Assault or Shield; meaning if a unit has gained multiple Disarm keywords from different sources, the unit will have one trigger for Disarm with a total of the sum of their Disarm values.
    • NEW RULE: Disarm keyword added.

Radiance Addition: Show Off

  • Show Off is a new keyword appearing on both units and spells in Radiance.
  • When you Show Off something, you reveal a card from your hand that matches the requirement, or pick a friendly game object (card or token) on the board with the appropriate characteristics.
  • Cards with Show Off can reference information from the shown off card or object. That information is locked in when the card or object is shown off, even if it’s referenced later.
    • NEW RULE: Show Off keyword added.

Rules Update: Copy Effects Layer

  • We saw some confusion on how copy effects work and their placement in the trait-altering layer. In the Radiance rules update, we’ve moved to clarify this by giving copy effects a layer of their own. The first layer is now for copy effects and all subsequent layers (trait-altering, ability-altering, arithmetic) have been shifted down to reflect this change.
  • Because copy effects only interacted with other copy effects anyway, there was functionally no reason for them to remain in the trait-altering layer. Our hope with this move is that it will be clearer that they only interact with other copy effects. Effects like the Mech tag appended by Experimental Hexplate in the trait-altering layer are not copied by copy effects.
    • NEW RULE: Copy Effects layer added.

Radiance Addition: Copy Game Action

  • To support and build on this clarification for copy effects, we’ve also added the copy game action to the game actions section.
  • This section also clarifies how game objects that are created as copies, like the tokens played by Zilean, Time Mage’s replacement effect, work; those game objects don’t have a copy effect applied to them, but are created directly with the copyable traits of the object it is a copy of, as if those were its own printed traits.
    • NEW RULE: Copy game action added.

Radiance Support: Additional Deckbuilding Decisions

  • Radiance’s Neeko, Blending In adds the first instance of additional choices made during deckbuilding, so we’ve added rules to clarify how those choices are made.
    • NEW RULE: Additional deckbuilding decisions added.

Radiance Support: Equipment Units

  • Orianna, Lady of Clockwork presents some unique rules scenarios for the game, including what happens to an Equipment that becomes a unit. We decided on the simplest answer: units can’t be attached to other game objects. If an attached game object becomes a unit, it detaches immediately.
    • CLARIFIED RULE: Units cannot be attached to other game objects.
    • CLARIFIED RULE: If an attached non-unit game object becomes a unit, it detaches as it becomes a unit.

Rules Update: Layer Calculations and Object Dependencies

  • We’ve added rules for layer calculations in an effort to support future interactions and clarify how the layer effects are calculated.
  • When calculating layer effects, each game object is treated individually. If a game object needs to reference information from another game object, the game evaluates that game object’s layer information before returning to calculate the original game object’s information.
  • If multiple game objects reference information from each other, instead evaluate all of their information simultaneously, layer by layer.
    • NEW RULE: Layer calculation procedure added.

Rules Update: Pick

  • We’re starting to see the word “pick” appear on cards, which will become even more important when Legacy releases early next year. Pick is the word we’re moving towards for when you make a choice that isn’t a target. We want to make it clear to players that when a card says for you to  “choose” something, that means you are targeting what you choose.
  • When the Legacy rules and templating change is implemented in card text, many cards that currently say “choose” will have their text updated to pick. We are doing some of that work in Radiance. As such, we can also make this clearer in the rules prior to the Legacy rules update.
    • NEW RULE: Pick added.

Rules Update: Conditional Clause Scope

  • In Vendetta we saw some players understandably confused over the scope of conditional clauses in instruction text. 
  • With the Radiance rules update, we’ve clarified what scope conditional clauses have in a given instruction.
    • NEW RULE: Conditional clauses scope added.

Rules Update: Finalizing Time Actions Scope

  • We received feedback that cards which referred to “you” when checking if costs were paid or actions were taken was confusing if control of the card is gained by another player. New rules have been added to clarify this.
    • NEW RULE: Instructions of a spell or ability may reference actions taken during Finalization. They will do so by checking whether “you” performed those game actions.
    • NEW RULE: These instructions check whether the game action was performed, not by whom. If another player gains control of the spell or ability after the game action was performed during finalization, it will still be considered true for the purposes of these instructions.

Rules Update: Making New Choices

  • In the Vendetta rules update we included a model for making new choices as used by cards like Mystic Reversal and Rebuttal. We received feedback that the rules were unclear, and we clarified in the Vendetta FAQ how the interim model would work. Upon review, we found we weren’t entirely satisfied with that implementation.  We decided to overhaul how new decisions are made to be simpler and more intuitive. 
  • When making new decisions now, all decisions must be made anew. You can choose to make the same decisions as made previously, but if you’re making new decisions, you can’t go halfway. 
  • Similar to the previous model, all decisions must be legal and valid; however, with this new model, any abilities that trigger on targeting, for example, will trigger again; even if you previously targeted the same unit. It should feel like you’re going through the process of choosing targets all over again.
    • CLARIFIED RULE: Making new choices updated.

Rules Update: Pending Item Target Legality

  • Players have long wondered whether pending items are legal to target with spells and abilities. It’s very rare that such a case is possible but, like many strange rules interactions in Riftbound, we can blame these few cases on Promising Future. We figured we might as well make it clear: Pending items are not legal targets for spells and abilities.
    • NEW RULE: Pending item target legality clarified.

Rules Update: 2v2 Scoring

  • The rules for 2v2 scoring were slightly contradictory. In the Vendetta rules update we cleaned them up, and in this rules update they’ve been fully aligned. Specifically, the final point and scoring eligibility special rules now apply only to teams that maintain control of a battlefield during their own or a teammate’s turn, and not during an opponent’s turn.
    • CLARIFIED RULE: 2v2 scoring updated.

Empower Abilities

  • Vendetta’s Kayle, Justified needed some support from the FAQ. We’ve codified that support with the Radiance rules update.
    • NEW RULE: Game Objects with Empower abilities may have or gain permissions to be Empowered multiple times. Such Game Objects ignore the normal “Play only if not Empowered.” restriction on Empower abilities.
      • Note that this means you can activate the ability even if you’re at your max number of empowered statuses. That is intentional! It just does nothing. That is also intentional.

Negated and Ignored Instructions

  • Insightful judges and players recognized some strangeness in the rules for linked instructions from the Unleashed rules update, made more apparent by rules added in the Vendetta rules update. In the Vendetta FAQ we clarified how those rules should function, and now we’re codifying that fix into the Radiance rules update.
  • If an instruction mistargets, that instruction is ignored. If an instruction fails to execute for any other reason, such as it being replaced, skipped, or being impossible to perform, it is negated. Instructions that are ignored will cause any later instructions linked to them to also be ignored. If an instruction is negated, later linked instructions will not be negated; they will still execute if possible. 
    • NEW RULE: Negated and ignored instructions added.

Mandatory Requirements and Restrictions

  • The Vendetta FAQ clarified how Dragon Roost and other mandatory requirements functioned together. We’ve codified that into the rules in the Radiance rules update with extra clarifications. We’ve also codified the concept of a restriction: that being an effect like Perched Grimwyrm’s “Play me only to a battlefield you’ve conquered this turn.” 
    • NEW RULE: Mandatory requirements added.
    • NEW RULE: Restrictions added.

Legacy Updates

As we’ve shared before, we’re preparing a major update to Riftbound rules with Legacy in January. To part the curtain some, this is a massive undertaking—we’re completely reformatting the rules documents to improve their readability as reference for players and judges.

We’re literally starting from the ground up, which will give us room to reduce redundant information, improve ordering, and generally clean up the rules documentation.

To be clear: this is about rewriting the rules to be more readable, and it won’t change how Riftbound’s mechanics actually work. 

As always, we do not update the rules of Riftbound or introduce card errata to manage the power level of any card or effect—if we ever need to manage a powerful card, we’ll use other tools. 

We’ll release an additional FAQ article after Radiance is released to further clarify remaining points of confusion for players and keep you updated as we learn more.

“辉耀群星”规则更新将于2026年10月16日生效

欢迎浏览《符文战场》“辉耀群星”系列的更新公告。本次更新涵盖“辉耀群星”新机制的玩法规则、“化神争锋”常见问题解答中的调整，以及对规则逻辑体系的完善，为今后的系列和机制做好准备。此外，我们还整理了一系列具体情境，帮助大家理解“辉耀群星”带来的一些较为复杂的互动。

“辉耀群星”特殊互动解析

虽然更新公告和核心规则主要是为裁判提供参考，但我们也准备了一些由设计团队编写的问答，帮助大家理解本系列中部分较为复杂的互动与卡牌。除本文之外，我们还会按照以往发布常见问题解答的时间安排，另行发布一篇常见问题解答。

虽然本文不是常见问题解答，但文中的解答同样属于官方判例的汇编。这些判例均以今天同步发布的《核心规则》文档和卡牌描述为依据。新版《核心规则》发布后，若其中有任何内容与本文档不一致，请以新版《核心规则》为准。

在本文档中，我们使用了一些特定的缩写，来表示卡牌文本中的符号。以下是一份简要指南：

  • [E]代表“休眠”
  • [M]代表“战力”
  • [A]代表“任意特性的1点符能”
  • [C]代表“与此牌特性相同的1点符能”
    • “急速”费用中的[C]需要与单位拥有相同特性；若单位没有特性，则变为[A]。
    • 其他情况下的[C]则全部视为符合卡面印刷情况的相应符能标志——这种用法是我们在设计过程中采取的简称！

如果我先打出“艾克 - 时间刺客”的主动技能，再打出一名单位，然后打出“来路不明的武器”的主动技能，此时会发生什么？该单位会在我的下个回合被摧毁吗？

你的单位因自身触发式技能而被摧毁的事件，会被“来路不明的武器”的效果替换。虽然该单位获得的文本是“在回合结束时，将我摧毁。”，但这与“在本回合结束时，将我摧毁。”含义相同。在之后的回合中，这个技能不会再次触发。

卡面描述中的“在回合结束时”，与“在本回合结束时”是同义表达，虽然给予单位这样的文本不太常见，但确实可能出现。如果该触发式技能结算后，单位仍留在场上，那么它的技能的触发条件将无法被满足，因此不会再次触发。如果单位在该触发式技能触发前移动到非场地区域，或从非场地区域移动到其他区域，它的所有临时状态都会被移除，包括这段给予的文本。这样一来，该技能将不再存在，因此也就无法触发。

相关规则：359.3.e.16.、124.1.

我可以通过“暗巷守护者”的[亮出]技能，亮出战场上一张正面朝下的卡牌吗？

不可以。卡牌正面朝下时，其正面的任何特征都无法被引用。

[待命]关键词只出现在卡牌的正面，也就是印有费用、名称、战力、规则文本等特质的那一面。只要卡牌正面朝下，其他卡牌和效果便无法引用其正面的任何信息。因此，即使这张正面朝下的卡牌对“暗巷守护者”而言是友方卡牌，它也不具有符合[亮出]要求的特征。请注意，[亮出]只会展示从手牌中亮出的卡牌。场上的友方物体在被[亮出]时不会被展示。因此，即使你想展示那张正面朝下的卡牌，也无法通过[亮出]来实现。

相关规则：811.5.a、129.4.

“时空断裂”的提示文本是什么意思？我可以自行决定顺序吗？

如果被放逐的所有单位都属于你，则你可以自行选择放逐的顺序。如果你控制了一些属于其他玩家的单位，并且也将这些单位放逐，那么你放逐的所有单位都要按回合顺序加入结算链，先从属于当前回合玩家的单位开始。

无论出于何种原因，都不能出现多个项目同时加入结算链的情况。如果多个结算链项目将被同时打出，则由其控制者决定这些项目加入结算链的顺序。如果多名玩家将同时在结算链上添加项目，则改为从当前回合玩家开始，按回合顺序依次添加各自的项目。对于“时空断裂”，每位玩家可以自行决定属于自己的单位被打出到结算链上的顺序（提示文本指的就是这一点）；但玩家之间仍须从当前回合玩家开始，按回合顺序依次将各自的单位打出到结算链上。

例如：你总共控制五名单位，其中两名属于对手。你打出“时空断裂”，选择全部五名单位。你将它们放逐，然后由每名单位的所属者将其作为待处理项目打出到结算链上。由于你是当前回合玩家，你先按自己决定的顺序打出属于你的三名单位，再由对手按其决定的顺序打出属于对手的两名单位。待处理的结算链项目按照加入结算链的先后顺序进行确认，单位则在确认后立即结算。因此，要从你最先打出到结算链上的单位开始，依次确认并结算链上所有待处理的单位，直到结算链上不再有单位为止。然后，再按照触发顺序确认这些单位的所有打出效果。最后，玩家可以对结算链上最新加入的项目作出反应。如果玩家没有作出反应，该项目就会结算，然后重复这一流程，直到结算链上的所有项目均已结算为止。

相关规则：303.2.a.

如果我打出“易位法师”的主动技能，选择一名6[M]的已强化“普朗克 - 海上霸主”，此时会发生什么？我可以打出“提灯亚龙”吗？

让“普朗克 - 海上霸主”返回手牌的事件，会被替换为给予其在本回合内[M]+3。你可以通过“易位法师”的主动技能，从手牌中打出“提灯亚龙”。

“易位法师”会先将一名单位返回手牌，再引用该单位的信息。如果该单位没有改变区域，而且在处理以其为目标的指示时仍是合法目标，那么这个主动技能就会引用该单位的当前信息。引用信息时，“普朗克 - 海上霸主”的当前战力为9[M]，因此你可以打出一名战力不高于9[M]的单位。

相关规则：359.3.e.13.、359.3.e.13.a.

如果我使用“奥莉安娜 - 发条魔灵”选择一件已贴附的武装，此时会发生什么？ 

当该武装变为单位时，将其从贴附的物体上卸除。虽然它的[装配]技能可以被激活，也可以成为[百炼]触发效果的目标，但它无法贴附到单位上，因此这些技能结算时不会产生任何效果。

在本次规则更新中，我们明确了：单位无法被贴附到其他游戏物体上。如果要将一名单位贴附到某个游戏物体上，首先必须让它“不再是单位”。如果某个非单位游戏物体变为单位，则它变为单位时，将其从贴附的任何物体上卸除。如果某个效果试图将一名单位贴附到另一个游戏物体上，却没有先让它“不再是单位”，则不会发生任何事情。

相关规则：143.5.、435.1.h.、718.6.

如果我使用“奥莉安娜 - 发条魔灵”选择战场上一件拥有[部署]的装备，此时会发生什么？

该触发式技能结算时，这件装备将变为单位-装备。如果其控制者没有控制该战场，这位玩家就会使该战场进入争夺状态，并在随后的清理中，将该战场上的战斗或法术对决标记为待发生。结算链清空后，这场法术对决或战斗便会开始。

相关规则：190.3.a.、323.7.、323.8.、323.11.、323.12.

如果我使用“奥莉安娜 - 发条魔灵”选择另一件装备，并让之前的单位-装备不再是单位，此时会发生什么？贴附在它上面的武装会被卸除吗？如果它是基地中一件拥有[部署]的装备，我可以移动它吗？

贴附在它上面的武装会继续保持贴附；如果它是基地中一件拥有[部署]的装备，也会继续留在基地。

虽然单位无法贴附到物体上，但其他物体没有这一限制。只要已贴附的武装本身没有变为单位，就会继续贴附在该装备上，即使该装备已经不再是单位。由于该装备没有战力数值，武装的战力加成不会生效，但其效果文本仍会对所贴附的装备生效。

大多数拥有[部署]的装备都会引用“此战场”或“据守此处”，留在基地时无法获得收益。不过，如果你想让它回到战场，可以用“奥莉安娜 - 发条魔灵”再次将它变为单位，也可以使用明确说明能够移动装备的移动效果，例如“指令：攻击”。

请注意，在确认“奥莉安娜 - 发条魔灵”的触发式技能从确认到结算，中间有一小段间隙：确认时，之前的单位-装备不再是单位；结算时，新选择的装备会变为单位。在这段间隙内，两件装备都不是单位（除非其中某件装备在首次被“奥莉安娜 - 发条魔灵”选中之前就已经是单位）。

相关规则：137.3.b.

“妮蔻 - 完美伪装”究竟是如何运作的？我要在什么时候选择传奇？我的卡组里每有一张妮蔻，我就能获得三位传奇吗？我可以把多张相同的传奇加入传奇区域吗？这些传奇会以活跃状态进场吗？我需要向对手展示它们吗？

你需要在构筑卡组时选择这些传奇。在竞技级赛事中，你必须将这些传奇登记在你的卡组列表中，并且可以将其与备牌一起存放。卡组中的所有妮蔻共用这三位传奇。你不能将多名相同的传奇加入传奇区域。这些传奇会以活跃状态进场。在它们被加入传奇区域之前，你无需向对手展示。

接下来，我们逐一说明妮蔻的规则文本。如果你的卡组（主卡组或备牌）中有一张或多张“妮蔻 - 完美伪装”，则除了开局使用的传奇卡牌之外，你还要挑选三名传奇。这三位传奇必须各不相同，也不能与你的卡牌传奇相同。无论卡组中有多少张妮蔻，你都只会以这种方式选择三位传奇。

当妮蔻的打出效果结算时，其控制者会从构筑卡组时选好的传奇中挑选一名，加入自己的传奇区域；只要妮蔻仍在场上，该传奇便会与其传奇卡牌一同留在传奇区域中。如果妮蔻离场，该传奇也会随之离开。只要这些传奇不在传奇区域，它们便不存在于游戏中的任何区域。也就是说，此时它们“根本不存在”。不过，如果这些传奇中的一名或多名已经在场上，玩家就不能再创建相同的传奇；构筑卡组时选定的每名传奇，最多只能有一名同时存在于场上。如果玩家通过某种方式打出了第四张妮蔻，则无法再向自己的传奇区域加入传奇。

以这种方式加入的传奇不是指示物。它们是传奇卡牌，在各个方面均与常规传奇完全相同。如果某个效果指示玩家“让一名友方传奇变为活跃”，则该玩家可以将自己或队友控制的任意一名传奇选为目标，并让其变为活跃。如果某个效果指示玩家让“你的传奇”变为活跃，此处的“你的传奇”指的是该玩家控制的任意一名传奇。这类效果不会将传奇选为目标；具体选择哪名传奇，要等到法术或技能结算时才会决定。

相关规则：103.1.、440.2.a.、440.3.b.、440.3.c.、355.10.g.

如果我使用“洪荒咆哮”亮出的场上单位，因“造化弄人”返回了我的手牌，此时会发生什么？我还能造成伤害吗？如果我打出“月神恩赐”，将那名单位从手牌中弃置，又会发生什么？

在这两种情况下，你都会造成伤害。

亮出物体时，所有会被引用的特征就已经锁定。无论这些物体之后会发生什么变化，亮出它们的卡牌仍能检查这些信息。这也意味着，如果你在亮出一名单位之后才给予它+[M]或-[M]，“洪荒咆哮”造成的伤害并不会因此改变；此时再想通过调整战力来影响伤害，已经来不及了。

相关规则：832.1.d.1.

“阿狸 - 自信闪耀”会将哪些情况视为降低单位的战力？假如我有一名1[M]单位已经被眩晕，其所在战场上还有一名敌方的“蕾欧娜 - 献身者”，那么我对自己的这名单位打出“训练有素”时，能触发对方位于同一战场的“阿狸 - 自信闪耀”的技能吗？

降低单位的战力，是指你控制的某个物体的技能使一名单位受到-[M]效果。如果你对一名已经被眩晕的1[M]单位打出“训练有素”，且该单位与敌方的“蕾欧娜 - 献身者”位于同一战场，就会触发“阿狸 - 自信闪耀”的技能。

虽然“训练有素”始终没有增加该单位的实际战力，但它的战力计算方式发生了变化：原本是在1[M]的基础上应用[M]-0效果，这不会触发“阿狸 - 自信闪耀”的技能；之后则变为在3[M]的基础上应用[M]-2效果。这种状态变化会触发“阿狸 - 自信闪耀”的技能，就像一名3[M]单位被眩晕后，受到“蕾欧娜 - 献身者”被动技能施加的[M]-2效果一样。请注意，这并非适用于其他所有情况：如果一名已经被眩晕的3[M]单位与敌方的“蕾欧娜 - 献身者”位于同一战场，对其打出“训练有素”，不会让它受到新的战力降低效果，因此也不会触发“阿狸 - 自信闪耀”的技能。法术、触发式技能和主动技能的情况则更简单：只要这类法术或技能对一名单位施加了数值不为0的-[M]效果，就会触发“阿狸 - 自信闪耀”的技能。

核心规则变动

“破限”与“化神争锋”的规则更新，已经为本次更新奠定了较为稳固的基础。我们根据实际需要，对规则作出了一些小幅调整。与以往相比，本系列需要修补的逻辑漏洞已经减少，不需要对规则进行大幅修正。本次更新中的绝大多数规则，都与“辉耀群星”的新卡牌和新机制有关。

接下来，我们一起来看看“辉耀群星”即将迎来的规则变动吧！

—

“辉耀群星”新机制：部署

  • “辉耀群星”为装备引入了新关键词[部署]。顾名思义，玩家可以在战场部署特定装备，改变该战场的局势。
  • 拥有[部署]的装备可以被打出到任意战场，包括敌方占领的战场、友方战场和无人控制的战场。不过，当对手据守战场时，你在该战场上拥有[部署]的装备都会被摧毁。
  • 只要未被摧毁，拥有[部署]的装备就会留在当前战场上。部分效果也能将这些装备移动到其他战场！
    • 新规则：添加“部署”关键词。

“辉耀群星”新机制：缴械

  • “辉耀群星”为单位引入了新关键词[缴械]。
  • 缴械是一种进攻触发。每场战斗中，当一名拥有[缴械]的单位首次进攻时，会给予其所在战场上的一名敌方单位在本回合内[M]-1。如果该单位具有[缴械2]，则会给予一名敌方单位在本回合内[M]-2。
  • 和[强攻]、[坚守]一样，[缴械]也可以叠加。也就是说，如果一名单位从不同来源获得了多个[缴械]关键词效果，这些[缴械]会合并为一次触发，数值等于所有[缴械]数值之和。
    • 新规则：添加“缴械”关键词。

“辉耀群星”新机制：亮出

  • “辉耀群星”为单位和法术引入了新关键词[亮出]。
  • [亮出]某个对象时，你需要从手牌中展示一张符合要求的卡牌，或从场上挑选一个具有相应特征的友方游戏物体（卡牌或指示物）。
  • 拥有[亮出]的卡牌，可以引用所亮出的卡牌或物体的信息。这些信息会在[亮出]时锁定，即使之后再引用，也会以[亮出]时的信息为准。
    • 新规则：添加“亮出”关键词。

规则更新：复制效果层

  • 此前，复制效果被归在特质变更层。我们发现，一些玩家对复制效果的运作方式（以及这个归类本身）存有疑惑。因此，在“辉耀群星”规则更新中，我们为复制效果单独设立了一个效果层，让相关规则更加明确。调整后，第一层专门用于处理复制效果，后续各个效果层（特质变更、技能变更、数值运算）则依次顺延。
  • 之所以这样调整，是因为复制效果原本就只会与其他复制效果互动。从实际运行的角度来看，没有必要继续将它们放在特质变更层。我们希望这次调整能让玩家更清楚地理解这种关系：复制效果只会与其他复制效果互动。例如，“海克斯注力刚壁”会在特质变更层赋予“机械”标签，而这类效果不会被复制效果复制。
    • 新规则：添加复制效果层。

“辉耀群星”新机制：复制游戏行动

  • 为配合上述说明，进一步明确复制效果的运作方式，我们还在游戏行动章节中加入了“复制”这一行动。
  • 这一章节也详细说明了以复制体形式创建的游戏物体应如何运作。例如，“基兰 - 时间法师”的替换效果打出的指示物，就属于这类游戏物体。在创建这类游戏物体时，并不会对其应用复制效果。它们会直接具有被复制物体的可复制特质，如同这些特质原本就印刷在其卡面上。
    • 新规则：添加“复制”游戏行动。

“辉耀群星”规则支持：卡组构筑时的额外决策

  • “辉耀群星”中的“妮蔻 - 完美伪装”首次引入了在构筑卡组时做出额外选择的机制。因此，我们新增了规则，说明这些选择应如何做出。
    • 新规则：添加卡组构筑时的额外决策的相关规则。

“辉耀群星”新机制：武装单位

  • “奥莉安娜 - 发条魔灵”为游戏带来了一些独特的规则情况，比如：武装变成单位后会怎样？我们采用了最简单的处理方式：单位无法被贴附到其他游戏物体上。如果一个已贴附的游戏物体变为单位，就会立即卸除。
    • 规则阐明：单位无法被贴附到其他游戏物体上。
    • 规则阐明：如果一个已贴附的非单位游戏物体变为单位，则它会在变为单位时从原卡牌上卸除。

规则更新：效果层计算与物体间的依赖关系

  • 我们新增了效果层计算的相关规则，目的是为今后可能出现的互动做好准备，并进一步明确各层效果的计算方式。
  • 计算各层效果时，需要针对各个游戏物体进行分别处理。如果某个游戏物体需要引用另一个游戏物体的信息，则先计算被引用物体的信息，完成后再回来计算原物体的信息。
  • 如果多个游戏物体相互引用信息，则改为按效果层逐层处理。在每一层中，同时计算这些物体的信息。
    • 新规则：添加效果层计算流程。

规则更新：挑选

  • “挑选”一词已经开始出现在卡牌上，等到明年初的“传承”系列推出后，这个词会变得更加重要。今后，对于不涉及目标选取的选择，我们将逐步改用“挑选”来进行表述。我们希望让玩家清楚地知道：当卡牌要求你“选择”某个对象时，就是要将该对象选为目标。
  • “传承”系列针对规则与文本模板的相关调整落实后，许多目前使用“选择”的卡牌都会改用“挑选”。其中一部分调整会在“辉耀群星”系列中先行实施。因此，我们也可以在“传承”系列规则更新前，先在规则中明确这一区别。
    • 新规则：添加“挑选”的相关规则。

规则更新：条件从句的作用范围

  • 在“化神争锋”中，一些玩家不清楚指示文本中的条件从句究竟约束哪些内容。这种疑惑完全可以理解。 
  • 在“辉耀群星”规则更新中，我们明确了条件从句在一项指示中的作用范围。
    • 新规则：添加条件从句作用范围的相关规则。

规则更新：确认期间执行行动的判定范围

  • 有玩家反馈，一些卡牌在检查费用是否已支付或行动是否已执行时，会使用“你”这一表述；但如果另一名玩家获得了卡牌的控制权，这个“你”究竟指代谁，就容易产生歧义。我们新增了相关规则，说明这类情况的正确处理方式。
    • 新规则：法术或技能的指示可以引用确认期间执行的行动，具体方式是检查“你”是否已执行相关游戏行动。
    • 新规则：这些指示检查的是相关游戏行动是否已执行，不会检查由谁执行。只要该行动已在确认期间执行，即使之后另一名玩家获得了该法术或技能的控制权，这些指示仍会判定相应条件成立。

规则更新：做出新的选择

  • 在“化神争锋”规则更新中，我们曾为“倒转神通”和“灵魂折镜”等卡牌引入了一套处理规则，说明“做出新选择”应如何进行。后来，有反馈指出这些规则不够清晰，我们便在“化神争锋”常见问题解答中进一步说明了这套临时方案的运作方式。然而，经过重新审视，我们发现这样的处理方式仍有不够理想的地方。为此，我们决定重新设计整个“做出新的选择”流程，使其变得更加简单直观。 
  • 现在，如果要做出新的选择，就必须重新做出全部选择。重新做出的选择可以与之前相同，但不能“只对其中一部分进行重新选择”。 
  • 与之前方案相同，所有选择都必须合法有效。而在新方案下，任何在目标选取时触发的技能也会再次触发，即便重新选择的目标与之前是同一名单位也是如此。整个过程就像重新走了一遍目标选取的流程。
    • 规则阐明：更新“做出新的选择”的相关规则。

规则更新：待处理项目的目标合法性

  • 长期以来，玩家一直存在一个疑问：待处理项目能否成为法术和技能的合法目标？会涉及这一问题的情况其实非常罕见，而它和《符文战场》中许多奇特的规则互动一样，都是“光明未来”惹的祸。既然如此，我们就趁这个机会把规则说明白：待处理项目不能成为法术或技能的合法目标。
    • 新规则：明确待处理项目的目标合法性。

规则更新：2v2得分

  • 2v2得分规则此前存在一些相互矛盾之处。我们在“化神争锋”规则更新中进行过梳理，而本次更新则让相关规则完全一致。具体来说，关于最后一分和得分资格的特殊规则，现在仅适用于队伍在己方成员的回合内持续控制一处战场的情况。这里既包括你自己的回合，也包括队友的回合；而在对手的回合内，这些特殊规则不适用。
    • 规则阐明：更新2v2得分规则。

强化技能

  • 此前，我们通过常见问题解答，补充说明了“化神争锋”中“凯尔 - 正义天降”的相关规则。而在“辉耀群星”规则更新中，这些补充说明已正式成为规则的一部分。
    • 新规则：拥有[强化]技能的游戏物体，可能本身就具有被多次强化的权限，也可能在之后获得这一权限。具有这项权限的游戏物体会无视[强化]技能通常具有的“仅在未强化时打出”这一限制。
      • 请注意，即使该物体拥有的强化状态数量已达到上限，你仍然可以激活这个技能。没错，这是有意设计的！只不过，这个技能不会产生任何效果，这一点也是有意设计的。

撤销与无视指示

  • 一些细心的裁判和玩家发现，“破限”规则更新中的关联指示规则存在一些不太合理的地方，而“化神争锋”新增的规则，又让这些问题变得更加明显。我们在“化神争锋”常见问题解答中讲解过这些规则的运作方式。现在，我们准备将相应修正纳入“辉耀群星”规则更新。
  • 如果一项指示的目标指定失效，该指示就会被无视。如果指示因其他原因无法执行，例如被替换、被跳过或无法完成，则会被撤销。一项指示被无视后，后续与其关联的指示也会被无视。但如果一项指示被撤销，后续关联指示不会因此被撤销，只要能够执行，就仍会执行。 
    • 新规则：添加撤销与无视指示的规则。

强制要求与限制

  • “化神争锋”常见问题解答说明了“龙栖峰”的效果如何与其他强制要求共同生效。在“辉耀群星”规则更新中，我们已将这些说明正式纳入规则，并进一步补充了相关解释。此外，我们还正式定义了“限制”这一概念，以“栖息的冥龙”为例，它的效果规定：“你只能将我打出到你本回合征服的战场上”，这就是一种限制。 
    • 新规则：添加强制要求的相关规则。
    • 新规则：添加限制的相关规则。

“传承”系列更新预告

我们也向大家介绍过，我们正在筹备一次《符文战场》规则的重大更新，将在1月与“传承”系列一同推出。先向大家透露一点：这是一项庞大的工程，我们正在对规则文档的格式进行全面更新，以便玩家和裁判查阅。

这次我们会把整份文档从头重写，删减重复的信息、优化各部分内容的顺序，让整份规则文档更加清晰、更有条理。

需要说明的是：此次重写的目的是让规则更易读，并不会改变《符文战场》各项机制的实际运作方式。 

和之前一样，我们不会通过修改《符文战场》的规则或发布卡牌勘误来调整任何卡牌或效果的强度。如果确实需要处理强度过高的卡牌，我们会采用其他手段。 

“辉耀群星”系列发售后，我们还会另行发布一篇常见问题解答，对玩家仍有疑惑之处作进一步说明，并根据后续了解到的新情况，持续为大家带来更新。

Hey Riftbounders!

We’ve got some fresh card errata for you today, covering cards from Radiance. If you’re just starting Riftbound, or new to TCGs, card errata refers to any updates to card text after a card was printed. We do this to make cards more easily understood and to clarify how they work within the rules of the game.

Radiance Cards

Elnuk Herd

[NEW TEXT] 

[Hidden] (Hide now for [A] to react with later for [0].)

When you play me, give a friendly unit +3 [M] this turn, then recycle me if I was played from face down.

▲
[OLD TEXT]

[Hidden] (Hide now for [A] to react with later for [0].)

When you play me, give another friendly unit +3 [M] this turn, then recycle me if I was played from face down.

Last Caress

[NEW TEXT] 

[Reaction] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)

The next unit you play this turn, even from face down, can be played to any battlefield. When you play it, [Buff] it. (Give it a +1 [M] buff if it doesn't have one.)

▲
[OLD TEXT]
 

[Reaction] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)

The next unit you play this turn (even from face down) can be played to any battlefield. When you play it, [Buff] it. (Give it a +1 [M] buff if it doesn't have one.)

Forbidden Technique

[NEW TEXT] 

Ready a unit.

When you play a card with Energy cost [7] or more, you may play this from your trash for [1][C][C]. Then banish this.

▲
[OLD TEXT]

Ready a unit.

When you play a card with Energy cost [7] or more, you may play this from your trash for [1][C][C]. Banish this.

Neeko, Blending In

[NEW TEXT] 

(Neutral cards can go in decks of any Domain.)

If Neeko is in your deck, choose up to 3 different legends in addition to your starting legend. (Different means none match names.)

When you play me, choose one of those Legends and add it to your Legend Zone while I'm on the board.

▲
[OLD TEXT]

(Neutral cards can go in decks of any Domain.)

If Neeko is in your deck, choose 3 different legends in addition to your starting legend. (Different means none match names.)

When you play me, choose one of those Legends and add it to your Legend Zone while I'm on the board.

Welcome to the Radiance FAQ article! As mentioned in the Radiance Release Notes article, the FAQ article serves as a collection of rulings and clarifications at our usual cadence, and serves as an additional supplemental article to the Release Notes article.

The FAQ is a collection of official rulings. In places where the FAQ differs from the Core Rules Document, the FAQ takes precedence. When a new Core Rules Document is released, it will take precedence over any points that differ from this document. 

Throughout this document, we use some specific shorthand to represent symbols in card text. Here’s a short guide:

  • [E] means “exhaust”
  • [M] means “Might”
  • [A] means “one power of any domain”
  • [C] means “one power of this card’s domain”
    • [C] in Accelerate costs takes on the domain of the Unit, or turns into [A] if the Unit has no domain or multiple domains.
    • [C] in other cases is treated as the corresponding power symbol in all respects, matching how the cards are actually printed—it’s just a design shorthand!

—

If my opponent empowers Kharox and chooses to play my Neeko, Blending In from my trash with the triggered ability, do they get one of the Legends I chose during deckbuilding?

No.

When the play effect of the Neeko played through Kharox resolves, if their deck has one or more copies of Neeko, Blending In, they can add one of the Legends they chose during deckbuilding to their Legend Zone as if they had played a copy of Neeko that they own. The Legends they add to the Legend Zone don’t have any relation to the Legends their opponent chose. If their deck has no copies of Neeko, in the Main Deck or the sideboard, that instruction will be ignored.

If I play Mobilize while I control Seraphic Wyvern and I only have one rune left in my Rune Deck, do I still draw a card?

No.

Referencing the action in this way refers only to the game action and the game object it was performed on. The channel event that Seraphic Wyvern instructs introduces a new game object that the action is performed on, but the referenced action is still only the original one in the instructions of the spell.

The same logic applies to Catalyst of Aeons played while its controller has a Seraphic Wyvern on the board and only two runes left in their Rune Deck. They were able to channel 2 runes, even if the additional game object instructed to be channeled by Seraphic Wyvern wasn’t possible. Therefore they will not draw 1.

Relevant rules: 359.3.e.14.c.

If I play Meticulous Restorationist from my trash for [Y] via its triggered ability, can I banish a unit or gear from my trash with Mordekaiser, Iron Revenant to pay the cost?

Yes.

“Play me for [Cost]” is an alternate cost which replaces the base cost ([2]) with the alternate cost ([Y]). Mordekaiser, Iron Revenant’s Power can only be spent to play units.

Relevant rules: 356.1.a.

If I play Atakhan and kill a non-token unit for its additional cost, can I banish that unit with Mordekaiser, Iron Revenant to help pay for Atakhan’s Power cost?

No.

When paying costs in Riftbound, you pay Energy and Power costs before you perform other “non-standard” costs, like Atakhan’s optional additional cost to kill a unit. When paying the Power cost of Atakhan, the unit in question is not actually dead yet, and thus cannot be banished from your trash.

Relevant rules: 357.1., 357.2.

If I kill Runeblade Anvil during an opponent’s turn, when is the last moment I can play the banished card?

You can play it until the Ending Phase in your next turn begins.

If I kill Runeblade Anvil during my turn, can I play the card during the Ending Phase of that turn?

No.

The duration for Runeblade Anvil’s permission is “until your next Ending Phase.” It is valid until the specified point in the specified turn begins, and then the permission is lost.

If I kill Runeblade Anvil during my Ending Phase, when is the last moment I can play the banished card?

You can play it until the Ending Phase in your next turn begins.

Your next Ending Phase after your current Ending Phase is the one in your next turn. Until that Ending Phase begins, you will be able to play the card in question.

If I control Hunters’ Circle and I play Baron Nashor without a Baron Pit on the board, can I play him for [9][C][C][C]?

Yes.

Hunters’ Circle applies a cost reduction to the first unit or gear each player plays there during their turn. Baron Nashor entering at the Baron Pit is a replacement effect that applies while Baron resolves and enters the board. In comparison, Hunters’ Circle’s cost reduction is in effect during finalization, when choosing play locations in step 2 and determining the total cost in step 3. By the time Baron Nashor’s replacement effect applies, his cost has been determined and paid.

Relevant rules: 355.2.

If I control a battlefield and I have Riven, the Exile as my legend, can I play Baron Nashor without a Baron Pit on the board and have him enter ready?

Yes.

Riven, the Exile applies a replacement effect to units her controller plays to a battlefield they control. This refers to step 2 of finalization, when players pick the play location for a unit they are playing. Riven then generates a replacement effect for those units, which causes them to enter ready. When Baron Nashor enters in this scenario, there are two replacement effects that apply to the event of him entering: him entering ready, and him entering to the Baron Pit. Regardless of the order of these replacement effects, Baron Nashor will enter ready at the Baron Pit.

Relevant rules: 355.2.

For Riven, Broken Blade’s exhaust trigger, do I spend the buff when finalizing the triggered ability or when it resolves?

When it resolves.

A cost within instructions that doesn’t appear as the first part of a triggered ability’s effect is part of the instructions that occur on resolution and not the base cost of the triggered ability. The first part of Riven, Broken Blade’s triggered ability is “Choose one that hasn’t been chosen this turn…”

Relevant rules: 383.3.b.

If I Standard Move a Riven, Broken Blade and a Stellacorn Herder simultaneously, which goes on the chain first: Riven’s exhaust trigger or Stellacorn Herder’s move trigger?

The exhaust trigger.

The order of the triggers on the chain after the move event completes is: exhaust triggers first, followed by move triggers. The cost to perform the move occurs before the move action is actually performed.

Relevant rules: 203.

If I attempt to Standard Move to a battlefield with Gravity Field and decline the cost, can I still exhaust my unit?

No.

The Standard Move is an inherent ability. We’ll clarify some established consensus on how the Standard Move operates: you cannot attempt to perform the Standard Move if the resulting move is not possible, nor if you cannot pay its associated costs.

Additionally, if the Standard Move incurs a Cost that cannot be paid, or if the move action cannot otherwise be performed, the Standard Move and all actions taken as part of performing it will be undone, any effects those actions caused to occur are similarly undone, and the Standard Move will be cancelled.

If I play Charm moving an enemy unit to a battlefield where I control Gravity Field, does its controller have to pay the cost?

No.

The opponent must pay [1][A] to move a unit to the battlefield with Gravity Field, but Charm instructs you to move the enemy unit and not your opponent.

If your opponent controlled the Gravity Field at that battlefield, you would be the one who would have to pay [1][A] to move the enemy unit to that battlefield when Charm resolves.

Relevant rules: 412.2. and its subrules

What about if I play Angler Wyrm’s activated ability while it’s located at the same battlefield with Gravity Field? Will they have to pay the cost to move the unit to the battlefield?

Yes.

Unlike Charm, Angler Wyrm instructs your opponent to move their unit, so they must pay the cost in order to move it to that battlefield. If they choose not to or can’t, the unit does not move.

Relevant rules: 412.2. and its subrules, 204.4., 204.4.b., 204.4.c. 

Speaking of Angler Wyrm, if my opponent plays Angler Wyrm’s activated ability choosing me and I play Hunker Down on one of my units, can I pick that unit when Angler Wyrm instructs me to move a unit even if I control other units?

No, you cannot.

The chosen opponent must perform the move game action if they have a unit that can move. If they control some number of units that cannot move, they cannot choose to “move” those units to satisfy the move instructions, as no move is actually possible. If they control no units that can move, the instruction is negated. If they have some number of units that can move, they must move one of those units.

If I play Possession and take control of my opponent’s Ekko, Revolutionary, can I play his activated ability to banish and then play him? Do I control him when he comes back in?

Yup and yup.

Relevant rules: 378., 191.2.

欢迎来到“辉耀群星”系列常见问题解答！正如“辉耀群星”发售说明中所说，我们会按惯例定期发布常见问题解答，集中整理各项规则判例与疑难解答，作为发售说明的补充文档。

本常见问题解答是一份官方判例的汇编。如果本文档与《核心规则》存在任何不一致之处，请以本文档为准。新版《核心规则》发布后，若其中有任何内容与本文档不一致，请以新版《核心规则》为准。 

在本文档中，我们使用了一些特定的缩写，来表示卡牌文本中的符号。以下是一份简要指南：

  • [E]代表“休眠”
  • [M]代表“战力”
  • [A]代表“任意特性的1点符能”
  • [C]代表“与此牌特性相同的1点符能”
    • “急速”费用中的[C]需要与单位拥有相同特性；若单位没有特性，则变为[A]。
    • 其他情况下的[C]则全部视为符合卡面印刷情况的相应符能标志——这种用法是我们在设计过程中采取的简称！

—

如果对手强化了“卡洛克斯”，并通过其触发式技能选择从我的废牌堆中打出我的“妮蔻 - 完美伪装”，该对手会获得我在构筑卡组时选定的某位传奇吗？

不会。

当通过“卡洛克斯”打出的“妮蔻 - 完美伪装”的打出效果结算时，如果该玩家的卡组中包含至少一张“妮蔻 - 完美伪装”，那么就可以将该玩家在构筑卡组时选定的一名传奇加入自己的传奇区域。其处理方式与该玩家打出属于自己的妮蔻时相同。该玩家加入传奇区域的传奇，与其对手选定的传奇没有任何联系。如果该玩家的主卡组和备牌中都没有“妮蔻”，则无视这项指示。

如果我在控制“天界双足龙”时打出“动员”，且我的符文牌堆中只剩下一枚符文，此时我还能抽一张牌吗？

不能。

以这种方式引用的行动，仅指代该游戏行动及其作用于的游戏物体。“天界双足龙”所指示的召出事件会引入一个新的游戏物体来执行该行动，但被指代的行动仍然仅限于法术指示中的原始行动。

如果玩家在场上有“天界双足龙”，且符文牌堆中仅剩两枚符文，此时打出“万世催化石”也适用同样的逻辑。即使无法召出“天界双足龙”所指示召出的额外游戏物体，该玩家仍然能够召出两枚符文。因此，该玩家不会抽一张牌。

相关规则：359.3.e.14.c.

如果我通过“细心的修复师”的触发式技能，从我的废牌堆中以[Y]的费用将其打出，我是否能利用“莫德凯撒 - 铁铠冥魂”放逐废牌堆中的一张单位或装备，来支付这笔费用？

可以。

“以[费用]的费用打出我”是一种替代费用，会将基础费用（[2]）替换为该替代费用（[Y]）。而“莫德凯撒 - 铁铠冥魂”提供的符能可用于打出单位。

相关规则：356.1.a.

如果我打出“厄塔汗”，并摧毁一名非指示物单位来支付其额外费用，我是否能利用“莫德凯撒 - 铁铠冥魂”放逐该单位，来协助支付“厄塔汗”的符能费用？

不能。

在《符文战场》中支付费用时，需要先支付法力和符能费用，再支付其他“非标准”费用，例如“厄塔汗”摧毁一名单位的可选额外费用。在支付“厄塔汗”的符能费用时，该单位尚未被摧毁，因此无法从你的废牌堆中将其放逐。

相关规则：357.1.、357.2.

如果我在对手的回合中摧毁“符刃铁砧”，我最晚能在什么时候打出被放逐的牌？

你可以在自己的下一个回合结束阶段开始前打出这张牌。

如果我在自己的回合中摧毁“符刃铁砧”，我能否在该回合的回合结束阶段打出这张牌？

不能。

"符刃铁砧"所赋予权限的持续时间为"直到你的下一个回合结束阶段"。这项权限仅在指定回合

的相应阶段开始前有效；一旦进入该阶段，权限便会失效。

如果我在自己的回合结束阶段摧毁“符刃铁砧”，我最晚能在什么时候打出被放逐的牌？

你可以在自己的下一个回合结束阶段开始前打出这张牌。

因为你已经处于当前回合的回合结束阶段，要到下一个自己的回合才会再次进入该阶段。只要那个阶段尚未开始，你就仍可打出这张牌。

如果我控制着“猎风广场”，且场上没有“男爵巢穴”，我是否能以[9]和[C][C][C]的费用打出“纳什男爵”？

可以。

“猎风广场”的费用减免适用于每名玩家在自己回合中首次在该处打出的单位或装备。“纳什男爵”在“男爵巢穴”处进场是一个替换效果，在“纳什”男爵结算并进场时生效。而“猎风广场”的费用减免则在确认过程中便已生效，涵盖第2步的打出位置选择和第3步的总费用确定。因此，当“纳什男爵”的替换效果开始生效时，其费用已经确定并支付。

相关规则：355.2.

如果我控制着一处战场，且我的传奇是“锐雯 - 放逐之刃”，我是否能在场上没有“男爵巢穴”的情况下打出“纳什男爵”，并使其以活跃状态进场？

可以。

如果“锐雯 - 放逐之刃”的控制者将单位打出到自己控制的战场上，则会对这些单位应用一个替换效果。这里指的是确认过程的第2步：玩家为打出的单位挑选打出位置。然后，“锐雯”会为这些单位生成一个替换效果，使其以活跃状态进场。在这种情况下，“纳什男爵”进场时会受到两个替换效果的影响：一个使其以活跃状态进场，另一个使其在“男爵巢穴”处进场。无论这两个替换效果以什么顺序应用，“纳什男爵”都会在“男爵巢穴”处以活跃状态进场。

相关规则：355.2.

“锐雯 - 断剑之誓”的休眠触发效果，是在触发式技能确认时消耗增益，还是在结算时消耗？

结算时。

如果指示中的费用并非触发式技能效果的第一部分，那么这笔费用就属于结算时执行的指示，而非该触发式技能的基础费用。“锐雯 - 断剑之誓”的触发式技能的第一部分是：“选择一个本回合未选过的效果……”。

相关规则：383.3.b.

如果我同时对一名“锐雯 - 断剑之誓”和一名“天角牧者”执行标准移动，哪个触发式技能会先加入结算链：是“锐雯 - 断剑之誓”的休眠触发效果，还是“天角牧者”的移动触发效果？

休眠触发效果。

移动事件完成后，结算链上的触发式技能会按以下顺序进行排列：休眠触发效果在先，移动触发效果在后。这是因为执行移动所需的费用，会在实际执行移动行动之前支付。

相关规则：203.

如果我尝试通过标准移动，将单位移到有“重力场”的战场，但选择不支付费用，此时我还能让该单位变为休眠吗？

不能。

标准移动是一种自有技能。关于标准移动的处理方式，这里对已有共识作进一步说明：如果移动本身无法完成，或无法支付其相关费用，就不能尝试执行标准移动。

此外，如果标准移动产生了无法支付的费用，或移动行动因其他原因无法执行，则会撤销此次标准移动及执行过程中进行的所有行动。这些行动引发的效果也会一并撤销，标准移动随之取消。

如果我打出“魅惑妖术”，将一名敌方单位移动到我控制的“重力场”所在的战场，该单位的控制者需要支付费用吗？

不需要。

虽然对手将单位移动到“重力场”所在的战场时必须支付[1]和[A]，但“魅惑妖术”指示的是由你移动该敌方单位，而不是由对手移动。

如果该战场上的“重力场”由对手控制，那么在“魅惑妖术”结算时，就需要由你支付[1]和[A]，才能将该敌方单位移动到该战场。

相关规则：412.2.及其子规则

如果“提灯亚龙”与“重力场”位于同一战场，我打出“提灯亚龙”的主动技能时，又会发生什么？对手是否需要支付费用，才能将单位移动到该战场？

是的。

与“魅惑妖术”不同，“提灯亚龙”指示由对手移动其单位，因此对手必须支付费用，才能将单位移到该战场。如果对手选择不支付或无法支付这笔费用，该单位就不会移动。

相关规则：412.2.及其子规则、204.4.、204.4.b.、204.4.c. 

说到“提灯亚龙”，如果对手打出其主动技能并选择我，而我对自己的一名单位打出了“气敛神聚”，那么当“提灯亚龙”指示我移动一名单位时，即使我还控制着其他单位，也可以挑选那名单位吗？

不可以。

被选中的对手只要有能够移动的单位，就必须执行移动这一游戏行动。如果该对手控制着无法移动的单位，就不能选择“移动”这类单位来满足移动指示，因为这类单位实际上无法移动。如果该对手没有任何能够移动的单位，则撤销这项指示。如果该对手有可以移动的单位，就必须移动其中一名。

如果我打出“据为己有”，获得对手的“艾克 - 逆时而行”的控制权，我是否能打出他的主动技能将他放逐，然后再打出他？他再次进场后，仍由我控制吗？

能，而且仍由你控制。

相关规则：378.、191.2.
